title: Weather App User can view real-time current weather conditions for their selected location so that they know the present conditions there

milestones.notes: Handoff comment posted on Plane WEATHER-3. 8 testable AC, size M. Depends on WEATHER-2 (location search) for an active Location.

Self-planned 5 components: weatherClient (Open-Meteo current-conditions fetch, always metric), unitsConversion (pure conversion, no refetch on toggle), useCurrentConditions (staleness/last-good-data/units-default logic), CurrentConditionsCard + UnitsToggle (presentational, 'station observation slip' design direction via frontend-design skill). Requirements ledger created, 8 rows pending. Refresh Interval (10 min) and Units default (Metric) proceeding as documented assumptions from business-domain.md, per WEATHER-2 precedent.

All 8 AC implemented (6 planned components + weatherCodeSummary, formatObservedTime, CurrentConditionsContainer discovered during implementation). 58/58 tests, 100% coverage. Added missing src/vite-env.d.ts (Vite ambient types gap from WEATHER-2 scaffold). Pushed and opened PR #2.

next_step: Human reviews PR #2 on GitHub. On approval/merge, transition to Done.
